descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: double tap, self-send, outsider access.

Candidate N45 · proposed S2 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Tapping Send on the task review twice at once sends it twice (two records on each side)

Tickets: TFA-92585 (our own check) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (8b4be94a)

Note: Local, Hospital, both runs.

Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S17 Send cannot leak: no address or email in the flow, never to yourself, one delivery per tap, no outsider access

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The task list can be sent to another signed-in app user (an NP or covering physician) in-app only, through the Handoff delivery (same recipient picker, same in-app delivery), never by email (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • T2 The recipient opens the received list from their own account, read-only; the tasks do not become the recipient's own tasks (TFA-92585 AC 6; TFA-92585 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Sender, recipient and a third @roundai.test account (outsider); S01 census (Hospital) and S02 census (Nursing Home)

When In each context: open Send on Task Export and look at the picker; double-tap the final Send. As the outsider open each record's /handoffs/<id> address. After the run the harness counts the records and, as the recipient, tries to write to the sender's patients

Then No email field, no address, no mailto or share sheet; the sender is not in the picker; a double tap creates exactly one record per context on each side; the outsider sees 'not available' and none of the tasks; the recipient cannot change or read the sender's patients through the API

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U7 (signed-in recipient only, in-app only), U9, T2, U10. Picker checkpoints mustNotContain '@roundai.test', 'Email', 'mailto' and {sender}. Record counts from handoffs:list after the run, not from snapshot strings (oracleRules 6): exactly two task-list rows to {recipient} in the sender's Sent box — one holding the Hospital census, one the Nursing Home census — and the same two …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S17

Send cannot leak: no address or email in the flow, never to yourself, one delivery per tap, no outsider access

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for qa); TFA-92586 Handoff Summary: in app (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed (failed (the lane flagged no product issue)).

Detail:

Pass: no mailto / SMS / share, no list of accounts (an exact-email box is the stated design, TFA-92585 AC 13 — the matrix's 'no email field' is superseded); own email refused ('That's your own email…'); someone@example.com refused ('No Round Companion account with this email'); outsider opening /handoffs/<id> sees 'This handoff isn’t available to you.' and nothing of the list, API read null, no inbox row; recipient cannot read or change the sender's charts through the API. FAIL (2/2 runs): Hospital — two taps on the final Send within the same moment (two click events back to back) create TWO records on each side (sender Sent +2, recipient inbox 2). Nursing Home with a Playwright dblclick (two clicks a few ms apart): 1 record. The button is disabled only after React re-renders with sending=true, so a second tap before that sends again.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: seed-second-account, multi-session, permission-send-handoff, browser-events, mid-run-write. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
